title: THE SINKHOLE · The diner
venue: The Unprinted · a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for, found in Box 5 in the private years
logline: A Sunday page in a line almost Wood's, from a Louisiana paper's Sunday section, folded in Box 5 among the unprinted: a diner late at night, a bartender behind a well, a man at Table 14 smoothing his lapels, a dog under a booth. The signature in the margin is a mark nobody at Gully's recognizes. Wood never drew it. It's in his box.

panels.composition: A full Sunday page in three tiers, black and white: a diner late at night from the door; a man at a numbered table smoothing his lapels; a dog asleep under a booth with a cassette player on the table above it. The margin's signature is a mark, not a name.

image.prompt: black and white comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, a full comic page in three tiers showing a diner late at night from the door, a man at a numbered table smoothing his lapels, and a dog asleep under a booth beneath a table with a cassette player on it, a small unreadable mark in the margin
image.notes: Vol 5: D'Ambrosio's diner, Mr. D. Dean at Table 14, Faith under the booth, Elicia's cassettes. The page is not Wood's; the line is 'almost'. Whose: reserved.
